name: Ōtō (Fukuoka, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōtō town emblem in green: a disc with a white notch at the top and a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Ōtō, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ōtō town emblem — a disc with a white notch at the top and a stylised mountain
